entries.title: Pacific Drive
entries.definitive_edition: Pacific Drive on Windows PC with Whispers in the Woods

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with Whispers in the Woods available
primary.why: The Windows PC version launched alongside PS5 and remains the best high-end capture/settings route. Xbox Series X/S is now a valid route and launched alongside the Whispers in the Woods expansion, but no sourced exclusive content is limited to Xbox.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version on Steam or Epic Games Store, and add Whispers in the Woods for the expanded content path.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release through Steam and Epic Games Store, with scalable settings and DLC access.
all_releases.reason: primary: original launch platform with the best capture/settings ceiling and complete DLC route.
skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S release with Game Pass access and the Whispers in the Woods expansion launching alongside it.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong later console/subscription route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Xbox release coincided with Whispers in the Woods, but the DLC is also part of the PC content path; PC remains both complete and highest-flexibility.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Xbox Series X/S version is a later port, not a remaster. Whispers in the Woods is expansion DLC rather than a separate game entry.
